message: Hi, my kid Ruby is 8 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?

Hi! Yes, we do have Kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu for 8-year-olds. Ruby would be a great fit! We offer a free trial class so she can come check it out with no commitment. Would you like to get that scheduled?
Yes, that sounds great! What time do you have available for the trial class?
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! And what's the best email to send the trial class details to?
You can send the details to tester.birch@gmail.com.
Perfect! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Got it! And what's Ruby's full name?
Ruby's full name is Ruby Birch.
Thanks! And what's Ruby's date of birth?
Ruby's date of birth is February 14, 2018.

Perfect! Ruby is 8, so she's all set for our Kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu program. Here are some times available for her free trial class:

- Today Monday 7/6 at 5:30 PM
- Wednesday 7/8 at 5:30 PM
- Friday 7/10 at 5:30 PM
- Saturday 7/11 at 9:30 AM

Which works best for you?
Let's go with today, Monday 7/6 at 5:30 PM.

Perfect! Ruby is all booked for today, Monday 7/6 at 5:30 PM. You'll get a confirmation email at tester.birch@gmail.com with all the details.
Just have Ruby wear comfortable clothes she can move in. See you soon!
